location.contract: Protocol attaches Location middleware to these groups. Request ref chooses location[directory] or cwd and workspace query or x-orchestra-workspace header. The shared API Authorization middleware checks Basic credentials only when a nonempty configured password is required. response wraps data with actual Location.Info; this wrapper itself grants no authority.

global.contract: These groups are added without Location middleware and capture process/global services as shown in each body. API-wide Authorization still applies; when configured password is absent/empty its ordinary middleware is identity. A per-person user/role model is not established by that credential policy.

session.contract: Permission/question request-list and saved permission endpoints use Location middleware; their session-specific routes use SessionLocation middleware. Research artifact routes also use SessionLocation. That middleware decodes the path Session ID, loads persisted directory/workspace from SessionTable, refuses missing Session, and supplies its Location services. The local handler adds the ownership/binding comparisons described in its row.

capability.contract: The operator/connection/schedule factories attach CapabilityAuthorization as well as Location middleware. With a configured password it requires canonical Basic credentials and chooses operator.configured; without one it requires a 43-character bearer token and calls operator.authenticate. Idempotency key syntax is checked, a random request ID is created, and Core operator.withRequest receives the authority. Capability authentication-required/revoked failures map to constant UnauthorizedError, other capability failures to ForbiddenError; non-Fail reasons and annotations are preserved.

host_helper.contract: These are constructed service helpers, not independently routable grants. createRoutes takes host operator/verifier options; makeRoutes installs them as services or uses defaults. Default operator principal is the OS account (fallback local), scoped to instance placements and all action names. Content mint/read behavior is checked in the actual capability-artifacts consumer.

origin_helper.contract: CORS middleware is provided during API layer composition. The origin predicates and Vary behavior do not replace API Authorization or CapabilityAuthorization. Their exact permissive prefix/allowlist rules are the bounded claim.

public_static.contract: makeRoutes merges WebUi.layer separately from the constructed API. The static helper is public and applies HTML CSP while API endpoints retain their own middleware. No per-file authentication or symlink-safe open is established by the static helper.
